Dayjoy AI Enterprise Platform — Product Catalogue (Sample Document)
==================================================================

This is a sample plain-text document used by the RAG integration test
suite. It contains a mix of structured (headings + paragraphs) and
semi-structured (bulleted list, FAQ-style Q&A) content so the chunking
pipeline can be exercised against realistic input.

------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 1: Dayjoy Premium Health Tonic
------------------------------------------------------------

The Dayjoy Premium Health Tonic is the flagship product of the Dayjoy
AI Enterprise platform. Each 500 ml bottle contains a proprietary blend
of Ayurvedic herbs including ashwagandha, shatavari, amla, and
giloy. The tonic is formulated to support daily energy, immunity, and
overall well-being.

Key ingredients:
  - Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) — 200 mg per serving
  - Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) — 150 mg per serving
  - Amla (Phyllanthus emblica) — 100 mg per serving
  - Giloy (Tinospora cordifolia) — 100 mg per serving

Recommended dosage: 15 ml twice daily after meals, diluted in an equal
volume of water. Shake well before use. Refrigerate after opening and
consume within 30 days.

Pricing: The MRP is Rs. 699 for a 500 ml bottle. Distributors receive a
25% margin on the MRP. Volume discounts apply for orders above 100
units — contact your area sales manager for the current rate card.

------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 2: Distributor Onboarding
------------------------------------------------------------

To become a Dayjoy distributor, an applicant must:

  1. Submit the online application form available on the Dayjoy
     distributor portal.
  2. Provide a valid GST registration certificate and PAN card.
  3. Complete the mandatory online training programme (approximately
     4 hours) covering product knowledge, sales process, and the
     distributor compensation plan.
  4. Pay a refundable security deposit of Rs. 5,000.
  5. Be verified by the area sales manager, typically within 5–7
     business days of application submission.

Once onboarded, a distributor is assigned a unique distributor ID and
gains access to the distributor mobile app for placing orders, tracking
commissions, and viewing downline performance.

------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 3: Compensation Plan
------------------------------------------------------------

Distributor earnings are computed monthly and comprise three
components:

  - Retail profit — the difference between the distributor price and
    the MRP, paid upfront at the time of order.
  - Performance bonus — a percentage of personal sales volume (PV),
    paid monthly. The percentage ranges from 5% (for PV < 10,000) to
    20% (for PV ≥ 50,000).
  - Leadership bonus — paid to distributors who recruit and mentor
    downline distributors. Calculated as 5% of the downline's monthly
    PV, up to two levels deep.

Commissions are credited to the distributor's registered bank account
on the 10th of every month, subject to KYC verification.

------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 4: Customer Support
------------------------------------------------------------

Customers can reach Dayjoy support through three channels:

  - WhatsApp AI Assistant: +91-XXXXX-XXXXX (24/7, automated)
  - Voice AI helpline: 1800-XXX-XXXX (9 AM – 9 PM IST, Monday to
    Saturday)
  - Email: support@dayjoy.example

The WhatsApp assistant can handle order tracking, refund initiation,
product information queries, and distributor lookups. Complex queries
are escalated to a human agent within one business hour.
